# Copilot Instructions

This is the Bantay Kalsada project. Before doing any work, read these
context files in order:

1. `project-overview.md` — what we're building and why
2. `architecture.md` — stack, folder structure, and invariants
3. `code-standards.md` — rules every file must follow
4. `ai-workflow-rules.md` — how to work incrementally, what to protect
5. `ui-context.md` — design system and layout patterns
6. `data-model.md` — full database schema, RLS, and triggers

Always implement against these files. Never invent behavior not defined
in them. Check `progress-tracker.md` for current status before starting.
